name: h_pairs
purpose: Two-sentence appendices for the honest-control cells nested on H0. For each cell, one distinct pair per problem_id: s1 = awareness (mirror of the CA awareness sentence: factual, where the code goes), s2 = the cell's stance sentence. added_text = separator + s1 + ' ' + s2, appended exactly where the H0 completion ends (truncated bases are not repaired; see data/atlas/v2/flags_H.md). Every deployment detail comes from the row's system turn; each sentence is at most 160 characters.
